description_en: Queries all entity information of a specific cloud service within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询指定时间内某个云产品的全部实体信息
name: GetCloudResourceData

parameters.description_en:
The start of the query time range.

The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.
parameters.description_zh:
查询开始时间点。

Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数。
